entries.title: I Samuel 31:1
segments: And the Philistines fought against Israel. And the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down wounded in Mount Gilboa.

entries.title: I Samuel 31:2
segments: And the Philistines followed Saul and his sons. And the Philistines killed Jonathan and Abinadab and Malchishua, Saul's sons.

entries.title: I Samuel 31:3
segments: And the battle went hard against Saul. And the archers hit him, and he was sorely wounded by the archers.

entries.title: I Samuel 31:4
segments: And Saul said to his armor-bearer, Draw your sword and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised ones come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armor-bearer would not, for he was very much afraid. So Saul took a sword and fell on it.

entries.title: I Samuel 31:5
segments: And when his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell on his sword and died with him.

entries.title: I Samuel 31:6
segments: And Saul died, and his three sons, and his armor-bearer, and all his men, that same day together.

entries.title: I Samuel 31:7
segments: And the men of Israel beyond the valley, and who [were] on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled and that Saul and his sons had died. And they abandoned the cities and fled. And the Philistines came and lived in them.

entries.title: I Samuel 31:8
segments: And it happened on the next day, the Philistines came to strip the slain, and they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

entries.title: I Samuel 31:9
segments: And they cut off his head and stripped off his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to publish [it] in the house of their idols and [among] the people.

entries.title: I Samuel 31:10
segments: And they put his armor in the house of Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.

entries.title: I Samuel 31:11
segments: And when they heard about it, the people of Jabesh-gilead, what the Philistines had done to Saul,

entries.title: I Samuel 31:12
segments: then all the brave men arose, and they traveled all night. And [they] took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan, and came to Jabesh, and burned them there.

entries.title: I Samuel 31:13
segments: And they took their bones and buried [them] under the tamarisk tree at Jabesh. And [they] fasted seven days.
